key.name: base-size
key.description: Every text and icon size is a ratio of this value.

key.name: glass-strength
key.description: Scales the alpha of every translucent surface. 0 hides all glass, 100 is as designed, 150 is more see-through.

key.name: show-window-button
key.description: Whether to show the panel button that opens the all-windows search overlay.

key.name: show-workspace-names
key.summary: Show workspace name label and drag-over hint
key.description: Whether to show the workspace name in the panel and as a hint while dragging a window over a thumbnail.

key.name: group-apps-always
key.summary: Always group windows by app in the panel
key.description: When enabled, every app with more than one window on a workspace collapses into a single badged icon.

key.name: direct-mode-max-windows
key.summary: Windows before a workspace auto-collapses to group icons
key.description: Workspaces with more than this many windows collapse each app into a single badged group icon.

key.name: flyout-dwell-ms
key.summary: Dwell time before a flyout opens
key.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on a badged group icon during a drag before its window flyout opens, and how long a hovered flyout row takes to preview its window.

key.name: ext-ws-dwell-ms
key.summary: Dwell time before an external drag activates a workspace
key.description: Milliseconds to hover on a workspace thumbnail while dragging a file from another app.

key.name: reduce-motion
key.description: Disable fade, settle and flyout animations. Layout changes snap instantly.

key.name: thumbnail-min-width
key.summary: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail
key.description: Minimum width of each workspace thumbnail in the panel (pixels).
